title: Software Engineering Team Leader-Data License Analytics
description:
Bloomberg delivers billions of data points to hundreds of thousands of customers daily. When markets move, our customers need their data immediately and without fail. That's not a nice-to-have. It's the whole product.

The Data License Reliability & Analytics group exists to make sure that promise holds — and to make sure we keep it efficiently. Our new Pune-based DL Optimization & Automation team will build the AI tooling and the context layer that lets engineers, SREs, and AI agents across Data License reason about our systems the way our most experienced people do: which pipelines feed which products, where capacity is wasted, which risks are real, and what to fix first.

In this role, you'll build and lead a team that puts AI to work on one of the most demanding data platforms in financial services. Your team will create intelligent systems that make Data License leaner, safer, and easier to run:

Smarter use of infrastructure — finding where compute, storage, and other system resources are over-provisioned or idle, and turning that insight into action.

Sharper data products — analyzing how the datasets in our Data License packages are built, delivered, and used, so we can keep improving what we offer clients.

Security, risk, and compliance on autopilot — automating the evidence-gathering, tracking, and reporting that keep us ahead of evolving regulatory and security requirements.

Maintenance that runs itself — finding the routine upkeep that consumes engineering time and handing it to machines.

Underpinning all of this is an AI context layer you'll help design: a living, machine-readable understanding of our systems, data, and dependencies that lets engineers and AI agents answer hard questions in minutes instead of weeks.

You will lead a team of four engineers, setting its technical direction and driving projects from idea to delivery. You'll work closely with engineering teams across Data License and Bloomberg infrastructure — as well as our reliability teams in New York and Dublin — turning their hardest operational questions into tools they rely on every day.

**What you'd actually be working on**

* Building and leading the team. Build and grow a team of four engineers. Set a high bar for engineering quality and analytical rigor, run the team's planning and delivery, and create an environment where people ship useful things quickly and learn fast. You'll stay hands-on — this is a lead who writes code and reviews designs, not just one who runs meetings.
* The AI context layer. Design and evolve the knowledge foundation our AI tools stand on: architecture knowledge bases, semantic models and ontologies of our data and services, and knowledge graphs that connect code, configuration, telemetry, and incident history. You'll own retrieval quality across RAG and GraphRAG pipelines, decide how knowledge is structured, verified, and kept fresh, and make sure an agent's answer can always be traced back to a source.
* AI-driven optimization of systems, processes, and architecture. Turn one-off investigations into repeatable tooling. Build analytics that find underused machines and tenancies, unneeded storage and datasets, and architectural bottlenecks — and quantify the impact of acting on them. If we answered a question once by hand, you'll be figuring out how to answer it on demand.
* Agents and MCP tooling. Build MCP servers and AI agents that expose Data License systems and knowledge to engineers and to other agents, and use agent-to-agent (A2A) patterns to compose them into multi-step workflows. Work on context retrieval, prompt and tool design, evaluation frameworks, and the feedback loops that make these systems more accurate over time.
* Risk and compliance analytics. Own the automated analytics behind regulatory and risk programs such as emerging cyber-resilience regulation and enterprise risk management: scanning codebases and inventories, tracking remediation, and producing evidence that holds up to scrutiny from auditors and leadership.
* Tools people actually use. Build the web applications, dashboards, and reports (React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python) that put these insights in front of engineers, managers, and leadership, and make them self-service.
* Shaping the AI Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC). Help define how Data License builds software with AI agents — agentic development workflows, guardrails, and evaluation. Your team will be an early adopter and an example for the rest of the organization.
* Partnering across Data License and Bloomberg infrastructure. Work directly with application, platform, and SRE teams to understand their problems, review designs, and bring data to architecture decisions. You'll be the person teams come to when they want to know what a change will really cost, what it will save, and what it might break.

**What you bring**

* 7+ years writing production software, with strong Python and solid JavaScript/TypeScript
* 2+ years leading engineers — as a team lead, tech lead, or in a role where you owned a team's technical direction and delivery
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent hands-on experience
* Hands-on experience building with LLMs: RAG pipelines, prompt and tool design, agents, or evaluation of AI output quality
* Experience building full-stack applications, including React front-ends and Python back-end services and APIs
* A data-driven mindset: you measure before you optimize, you show your evidence, and you're skeptical of conclusions — including an AI's — that can't be traced to a source
* Strong communication skills. You'll lead a team in Pune while partnering with teams in New York, Dublin, and elsewhere, so you need to explain trade-offs clearly and build consensus without authority
* Willingness to pick up new tools fast — this field changes month to month

**What would set you apart**

* Experience defining evaluation frameworks for LLM and agent systems — retrieval accuracy, groundedness, regression testing

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The IT Business Senior Analyst is an intermediate\-level position responsible for liaising between business users and technologists to exchange information in a concise, logical and understandable way in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to continuous iterative exploration and investigation of business performance and other measures to gain insight and drive business planning.


Responsibilities:


* Understand, analyze and explain counterparty mark\-to\-future exposures on derivative books to regional users.
* Dwell deep into the Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA calculation methodologies for Credit risk/BASEL 3 and be able to verify, cross check the exposure profiles generated by the systems.
* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to generate exposure profiles for basic products
* Ability to trace the changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and/or agreements
* Work closely with developers to improve/refactor code base and ensure agreed changes are manifested correctly by looking analyzing post release exposure numbers
* Conduct meeting with clients and key stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze, finalize and receive formal sign\-off’s from approvers.
* Translate requirements into Business Requirement Document \[BRD], Functional Requirement Document \[FRD] and/or Minor Development Document \[MDD].
* Facilitate and drive project meetings with both business and technology teams.
* Develop and review test scripts with business users as well as technology team. Execute test scripts for System Integration Test (SIT) and User Acceptance Test (UAT).
* Co\-ordinate and/or conduct the Production Acceptance Testing (PAT) with the business users.
* Creates flow diagrams, structure charts, and other types of system or process representations.
* Manage changes to requirements and baseline through a change control process.
* Ability to read code
* Formulate and define systems scope and objectives for complex projects and foster communication between business leaders and IT
* Consult with users and clients to solve complex system issues/problems through in\-depth evaluation of business processes, systems and industry standards and recommends solutions
* Support system change processes from requirements through implementation and provide input based on analysis of information
* Consult with business clients to determine system functional specifications and provides user and operational support
* Identify and communicate risks and impacts, considering business implications of the application of technology to the current business environment
* Act as advisor or coach to new or lower level analysts and work as a team to achieve business objectives, performing other duties and functions as assigned
* Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
* Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy.
* Acts as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

7\-10 years of relevant experience


* Experience in data analysis with intermediate/advanced Microsoft Office Suite skills
* Proven interpersonal, data analysis, diplomatic, management and prioritization skills
* Consistently demonstrate clear and concise written and verbal communication
* Proven ability to manage multiple activities and build/develop working relationships
